description: Photos anciennes - Basse Normandie - Ports artificiels 1946 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. These are black and white shots of the metropolitan coastline. The shooting years ranged from 1919 to 1958. Due to proper archiving in an air-conditioned room, their state of conservation has remained good. Some of them are arranged in an album with a number and an assembly plan. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Ancient photos - Lower Normandy - Artificial ports 1946" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include avion, guerre, photographie, calvados, anciens, normandie. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
